'''prime-rl''' (Prime Intellect, v0.10.0) is an asynchronous RL trainer: FSDP2 for training, vLLM for rollouts, expert parallelism for MoE, and LoRA through a <code>[model.lora]</code> config block.<ref>[https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl prime-rl repository] and [https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl/blob/main/docs/advanced.md advanced docs]</ref> Environments are written with the companion '''verifiers''' library.<ref>[https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/verifiers verifiers repository]</ref> We found no evidence of Spark support.
